aboutGame.title: What is Idle Breakout?
paragraphs: Idle Breakout is an incremental brick-breaking game where you buy and upgrade an arsenal of balls that automatically bounce around and smash bricks. Each destroyed brick pays out cash that you reinvest into more balls, higher damage, and faster fire rates.

Progress is endless: clear a level, collect your reward, and unlock tougher brick layouts with more health and new colors. Prestige resets let you trade progress for permanent bonuses, while skill points and special ball types open up entirely new strategies for late-game play.

items.question: What is Idle Breakout?
items.answer: Idle Breakout is an incremental brick-breaking game where you buy and upgrade balls that automatically destroy bricks. Cash from destroyed bricks is reinvested into more balls, higher damage, and faster fire rates.

items.question: Which ball should beginners buy first?
items.answer: Start with cheap Basic balls to build steady income, then add Plasma or Sniper balls once you need higher single-target damage for tougher bricks and bosses.

items.question: How do I progress faster?
items.answer: Reinvest cash as soon as you can, prioritize damage and ball count upgrades, and prestige when progress slows to trade your run for permanent bonuses.

items.question: Does Idle Breakout have codes?
items.answer: Idle Breakout has no confirmed active codes. This wiki tracks any official codes and save-code information as soon as they are available.

items.question: Where can I play Idle Breakout?
items.answer: Idle Breakout is a free browser game available on Kongregate and Coolmath Games, and it also runs on mobile browsers.
